title: Admitto environment variables
intro: This page is the operator-facing dictionary for deploy env vars. Copy values from [`.env.example`](./.env.example). **Boot vs UI:** anything marked UI `none` must be set in the environment before the container is useful; mail, branding, and most identity settings can wait for Organisation settings after `/setup`.

vars.name: NODE_ENV
vars.summary: Use production for real deploys. Changes security defaults (HTTPS BASE_URL, private-mail lab flag ignored, etc.).

vars.name: BASE_URL
vars.summary: Public origin browsers use (https://tickets.example.com, no trailing slash). Required at boot in non-development; not configurable from Settings.

vars.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
vars.summary: AES-256-GCM master key (openssl rand -base64 32). Required to decrypt mail/OIDC secrets at rest. Losing it loses encrypted config.

vars.name: DATABASE_URL
vars.summary: Postgres URL. Password must match POSTGRES_PASSWORD when using compose db service.

vars.name: REDIS_URL
vars.summary: Redis URL including password. Compose builds this from REDIS_PASSWORD; keep them in sync.

vars.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
vars.summary: Redis requirepass. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32. Must appear in REDIS_URL.

vars.name: POSTGRES_USER
vars.summary: Postgres role created by the db container.

vars.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
vars.summary: Postgres password. Must match the password embedded in DATABASE_URL.

vars.name: POSTGRES_DB
vars.summary: Postgres database name.

vars.name: PORT
vars.summary: HTTP listen port inside the app container (default 3000). Map host ports to this, not to a different internal port.

vars.name: ADMITTO_IMAGE
vars.summary: ghcr.io/solarssk/admitto:X.Y.Z image pin (version without leading v).

vars.name: TRUST_PROXY
vars.summary: When true, honour X-Forwarded-* from peers allowed by TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS (required behind NPM/nginx).

vars.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
vars.summary: CIDR list of TCP peers allowed to set forwarded headers. Variant A: compose internal subnet in .env.example. Variant B (Portainer/NPM direct to app): use NPM's source on /32 only, not broad RFC1918 ranges.

vars.name: MIGRATION_BACKUP_DIR
vars.summary: Directory for nightly SQL dumps written by the db-backup sidecar (compose volume mounted at /backups).

vars.name: UPLOAD_DIR
vars.summary: Branding/upload root (compose: /app/uploads). Must be writable by uid 1000 (node). Health shows down when not writable.

vars.name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
vars.summary: local (default). Other providers are not production-ready yet.

vars.name: EMERGENCY_EXPORT_DIR
vars.summary: Non-public bind mount for break-glass CSV exports. Never put this under UPLOAD_DIR (/uploads is unauthenticated).

vars.name: EMAIL_PROVIDER
vars.summary: smtp | graph | powerautomate for env-seeded transport. Production UI config is preferred; export_only is lab dry-run only.

vars.name: MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS
vars.summary: Default From address when seeding mail from env.

vars.name: MAIL_FROM_NAME
vars.summary: Default From display name.

vars.name: MAIL_REPLY_TO
vars.summary: Optional Reply-To.

vars.name: MAIL_ENVELOPE_FROM
vars.summary: Optional envelope/MAIL FROM override.

vars.name: SMTP_HOST
vars.summary: SMTP hostname. Production blocks private/link-local targets unless listed in MAIL_PRIVATE_DESTINATION_ALLOWLIST (lab: ALLOW_PRIVATE_MAIL_DESTINATIONS when NODE_ENV is not production).

vars.name: SMTP_PORT
vars.summary: SMTP port (587 STARTTLS or 465 implicit TLS).

vars.name: SMTP_SECURE
vars.summary: true for implicit TLS (typically 465).

vars.name: SMTP_USER
vars.summary: SMTP username.

vars.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
vars.summary: SMTP password / app password.

vars.name: SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS
vars.summary: Require STARTTLS upgrade on plaintext ports.

vars.name: SMTP_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
vars.summary: Reject invalid TLS certificates (keep true in production).

vars.name: SMTP_HELO_NAME
vars.summary: Optional SMTP EHLO/HELO name.

vars.name: SMTP_POOL
vars.summary: Enable nodemailer connection pooling.

vars.name: SMTP_MAX_CONNECTIONS
vars.summary: Max pooled SMTP connections.

vars.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGES_PER_CONNECTION
vars.summary: Messages per pooled connection before recycle.

vars.name: SMTP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
vars.summary: Soft send rate cap for SMTP.

vars.name: SMTP_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
vars.summary: SMTP connect timeout (ms).

vars.name: SMTP_GREETING_TIMEOUT
vars.summary: SMTP greeting timeout (ms).

vars.name: SMTP_SOCKET_TIMEOUT
vars.summary: SMTP socket timeout (ms).

vars.name: POWER_AUTOMATE_URL
vars.summary: Power Automate HTTP trigger URL (treat as a credential; may embed a signed token). Same SSRF rules as SMTP host.

vars.name: POWER_AUTOMATE_KEY
vars.summary: Power Automate shared key / secret header value.

vars.name: GRAPH_TENANT_ID
vars.summary: Microsoft Graph tenant ID.

vars.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_ID
vars.summary: Microsoft Graph app (client) ID.

vars.name: GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.summary: Microsoft Graph client secret.

vars.name: GRAPH_MAILBOX
vars.summary: Mailbox UPN used as Graph send-as identity.

vars.name: GRAPH_SAVE_TO_SENT
vars.summary: Whether Graph keeps messages in Sent Items.

vars.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_MAIL_DESTINATIONS
vars.summary: Lab only. When true and NODE_ENV is not production, allow SMTP/IMAP/PA hosts on private addresses. Ignored in production.

vars.name: MAIL_PRIVATE_DESTINATION_ALLOWLIST
vars.summary: Comma-separated exact hostnames/IPs allowed to resolve to private addresses in production (self-hosted LAN MTA). Set on app and worker.

vars.name: BOUNCE_INGEST_TICK_SECONDS
vars.summary: Worker wake tick for bounce IMAP (default 60). Per-event poll decides when each mailbox is due.

vars.name: BOUNCE_INGEST_INTERVAL_SECONDS
vars.summary: Legacy alias of BOUNCE_INGEST_TICK_SECONDS.

vars.name: BOUNCE_INGEST_APP_URL
vars.summary: Internal base URL for worker → app System Logs bridge (compose: http://app:3000).

vars.name: ADMITTO_INTERNAL_URL
vars.summary: Optional alternate internal app URL used by worker integrations (compose sets http://app:3000).

vars.name: NIGHTLY_BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.summary: How many days of nightly-*.sql.gz files the db-backup sidecar keeps (default 14).

vars.name: NIGHTLY_BACKUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS
vars.summary: Sleep between nightly dumps (default 86400).

vars.name: ILA_IP_LOCATION_DB
vars.summary: Offline IP→country dataset id for audit/session geo (default user). No third-party lookup API.

vars.name: ILA_DATA_DIR
vars.summary: Directory for the offline geoip dataset cache.

vars.name: ILA_AUTO_UPDATE
vars.summary: Keep false so the process does not fetch dataset updates on its own.

vars.name: IMPORT_JOB_STALE_RUNNING_MS
vars.summary: Fail import AdminJobs stuck in running after this many ms (default 15 minutes).

vars.name: EXPORT_JOB_STALE_RUNNING_MS
vars.summary: Fail export AdminJobs stuck in running after this many ms (default 15 minutes).

vars.name: OPS_HEALTH_TOKEN
vars.summary: Bearer/X-Ops-Token (≥32 chars) for /readyz and worker System Logs bridge. Unset = /readyz disabled.

vars.name: LOG_HTTP_REQUESTS
vars.summary: 1 (compose default) writes redacted JSON access lines to app stdout. No IPs, cookies, or QR tokens.

vars.name: ALLOW_CHECKIN_BEARER
vars.summary: Emergency: re-enable Bearer check-in auth. Default false; warns outside development.

vars.name: CHECKIN_OPERATOR_TOKEN
vars.summary: Shared operator token when ALLOW_CHECKIN_BEARER=true.

vars.name: SESSION_TTL_OPERATOR_MS
vars.summary: Absolute operator session TTL override (ms).

vars.name: SESSION_TTL_ADMIN_MS
vars.summary: Absolute admin/superadmin session TTL override (ms). Prefer ≤8h when OIDC group mapping grants elevated roles.

vars.name: SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_ADMIN_MS
vars.summary: Idle timeout for elevated sessions (ms). Must not exceed admin TTL.

vars.name: SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_OPERATOR_MS
vars.summary: Idle timeout for operator sessions (ms).

vars.name: TRUSTED_DEVICE_DAYS
vars.summary: MFA trusted-device cookie lifetime in days.

vars.name: MFA_REQUIRED_ROLES
vars.summary: Comma-separated roles that must enroll MFA (default admin,superadmin).

vars.name: CF_ACCESS_ENABLED
vars.summary: When true with other CF_ACCESS_* vars, locks Cloudflare Access config from env.

vars.name: CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN
vars.summary: Cloudflare Access team domain URL.

vars.name: CF_ACCESS_AUD
vars.summary: Cloudflare Access application audience tag.

vars.name: CF_ACCESS_PROTECTED_PREFIXES
vars.summary: JSON array of path prefixes protected by Access.

vars.name: OIDC_ENABLED
vars.summary: Optional env seed for OIDC; production config is normally UI.

vars.name: OIDC_ISSUER
vars.summary: OIDC issuer URL seed.

vars.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
vars.summary: OIDC client id seed.

vars.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.summary: OIDC client secret seed.

vars.name: OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME
vars.summary: SSO button label seed.

vars.name: LOCATION_MAPS_ENABLED
vars.summary: Legacy/env maps enable; prefer UI External services.

vars.name: MAP_TILE_URL
vars.summary: Raster tile URL template.

vars.name: MAP_TILE_ATTRIBUTION
vars.summary: Tile attribution HTML/text.

vars.name: MAP_TILE_MAX_ZOOM
vars.summary: Max zoom for static maps.

vars.name: GEOCODING_PROVIDER
vars.summary: Geocoding provider id (Nominatim path by default).

vars.name: GEOCODING_BASE_URL
vars.summary: Geocoding API base URL (must not be private).

vars.name: GEOCODING_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.summary: Nominatim/geocoding HTTP timeout (ms). No UI field.

vars.name: MAPS_CONFIG_CACHE_TTL_MS
vars.summary: In-process maps config cache TTL.

vars.name: ADMITTO_DEFAULT_EVENT_TIMEZONE
vars.summary: Fallback IANA timezone when an event has none.

vars.name: WEATHER_ENABLED
vars.summary: Env seed for weather; prefer UI.

vars.name: WEATHER_PROVIDER
vars.summary: met_no | open_meteo (UI preferred).

vars.name: WEATHER_CACHE_TTL_MS
vars.summary: Weather response cache TTL.

vars.name: OPEN_METEO_BASE_URL
vars.summary: Open-Meteo API base (commercial / self-hosted).

vars.name: OPEN_METEO_API_KEY
vars.summary: Open-Meteo API key when required.

vars.name: OPEN_METEO_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.summary: Open-Meteo HTTP timeout (ms).

vars.name: EMAIL_DELIVERY_SNAPSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.summary: Days before rendered mail HTML/subject are nullified on terminal deliveries.

vars.name: SECURITY_AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
vars.summary: Days to keep durable security audit rows (default 30).
